content_descriptors.notes:
This game is intended for mature audiences only and contains content that some players may find disturbing.

Explicit Sexual Content: The demo contains suggestive themes, intimate situations, and partial nudity. The full version of the game features explicit, uncensored scenes of consensual intimacy between adult characters.

Violence: Scenes of violence against zombies, portrayal of self defense from humans, with depictions of blood and injury.

Complex Narrative Themes: Exploration of mature psychological topics. Exploration of complex and potentially distressing topics, including trauma, amnesia, confinement, and themes of human exploitation.

All characters depicted in the game are 21 years of age or older.
